verdict.rationale: Lorikeet documents an official MCP server that connects a Lorikeet account to Claude Code, Claude.ai, ChatGPT, Codex and MintMCP. It exposes concrete capabilities: diagnosing tickets, auditing knowledge bases, building workflows, testing tools, running simulations and exploring setup. Skills commands, an llms.txt entry and a probe confirming the docs page support this. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the server working, and documented setup/authentication details in the evidence.
